key_difference: (D) keeps the old TypesAreDeclaredMetaType structure and broadens the public QMetaTypeIdQObject specializations (PointerToQObject, IsGadget), which changes QMetaTypeId2::Defined globally; its completeness check also uses a named, non-TU-unique tag rather than an anonymous-namespace UniqueType threaded through is_complete, so it still has the cross-TU ODR/folding problem the reviewer flagged. (B) instead uses a local TypeIsSuitableForMetaType<Args, UniqueType> check with qMetaTypeId on the decayed types.
